inertDimensions.description: Dimensions every Brand Package declares that no shipped code reads, measured 2026-07-31 by compiling the real Tailwind pipeline rather than reading source. A skin can override these forever without moving a pixel. Shrink-only: give a dimension a consumer and delete its entry. This list records what was already true when the guard was written — it is not somewhere to park a new dimension so the gate goes green. spacing and controls were removed 2026-07-31: both were false positives from a detector bug (scripts/lint-inert-dimensions.mjs required var(--x) to close immediately, but every real caller writes a CSS fallback, var(--spacing-md, ...)). Compiling apps/web's real globals.css with @tailwindcss/node confirmed --spacing-md/--spacing-lg vary per brand (consumed by apps/web/src/components/theme-playground) and --control-height-* is read at 58 call sites in packages/design/ui/src/primitives/button-variants.ts and switch.tsx, density-driven via packages/design/tokens/src/brand-package/emit-css.ts. Both dimensions were already wired; only the guard was blind to it.

inlineI18n.description: Shrink-only. Inline two-language copy in every surface that renders translated UI (pick(), isZhUiLocale(), { en: ... } pairs, en/zh-keyed copy tables, branches on bare "zh", Forge pickBilingual). Copy belongs in the surface's catalog en.json; see scripts/lint-inline-i18n.mjs.

localeLists.description: Shrink-only. Files outside @nebutra/i18n that enumerate four or more language tags, each with the reason it is not the registry. See scripts/lint-locale-lists.mjs.

allowlist.reason: Blog posts are authored in en and zh only; this maps the post's content language to a date-format tag.
Decorative illustration of the i18n package — the tags are the picture, not a supported-language list.
Docs content is authored in en and zh only (Fumadocs i18n); the docs are a static export outside next-intl.

Locales that use CJK full-width punctuation — a property of the script, used to reject leaked punctuation.

uiHardcodedLabels.description: Shrink-only. Hard-coded English labels in @nebutra/ui (label props, aria-label, placeholder, sr-only text). New strings go through the labels contract in primitives/ui-labels.tsx; see scripts/lint-ui-hardcoded-labels.mjs.

noHardReload.$description: scripts/lint-no-hard-reload.mjs — refresh server data in place (useRevalidate / invalidateQueries / router.invalidate), not with location.reload(). Each reload entry states why a full load is required. Shrink-only.

reloadAllowlist.reason: Identity/workspace changed in another tab (boot configures the chart persistence scope once, before importing persistence modules), and the boot-failure retry button.
vite:preloadError chunk-load recovery after a deploy; guarded to once per window by sessionStorage.
The signed-in user changed under the form; persistence scope is bound to the boot identity.
Workspace switch and sign-out: IndexedDB/agent-session stores are named by the boot-time persistence scope (scopedPersistenceName) and the agent bridge is closed first.
Migrate: analytics consent should mount the gated providers from a consent store instead of reloading.

refreshAllowlist.reason: Locale cookie change: Next re-runs getRequestConfig on the RSC refresh; no server data changed.

noEffectFetch.$description: scripts/lint-no-effect-fetch.mjs — server reads go through TanStack Query (useQuery + route-loader prefetch) or RSC, not useEffect. This allowlist is the tracked P1-1 migration list; shrink-only.

hoverMotion.description: Shrink-only. scripts/lint-hover-motion.mjs, contract in docs/design-system/hover-motion.md. Measured baseline on origin/main 2026-10-10: 191 violations in 107 files; this list is what remained after the root fixes.
